item.title: Pulcini wins Latin America Amateur with playoff victory in Peru
item.description: Argentina’s Mateo Pulcini clinched a dramatic playoff victory over Virgilio Paz Valdes of Venezuela on Sunday to win the 2026 Latin America Amateur Championship (LAAC) at Lima Golf Club. The post Pulcini wins Latin America Amateur with playoff victory in Peru appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Two wanted after Augusta victim lured from ATM in Saturday robbery
item.description: Two suspects wanted in a Saturday armed robbery are believed to have slipped away as a SWAT team was responding to a home connected to the case, according to investigators. item.title: Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter
item.description: A Hephzibah mother of five who was caught on video beating and screaming at her 9-year-old daughter has been charged with child cruelty, authorities said. The post Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta agenda includes $2 million Broad Street incentive, Eisenhower paving
item.description: Augusta commissioners will take up an incentive aimed at finishing sections of Broad Street construction early, a contract supplement to resurface Eisenhower Drive ahead of the Masters Tournament and several affordable housing items during a Tuesday meeting.
